name: a dense mosaic of generated output opens the film
looks: A tight grid of small tiles fills the whole frame, each a different generated site or app screenshot, product photos, illustrations, 3D renders, dashboards, packed edge to edge with no gaps, establishing scale before a single word is said.
build: Tiles are absolutely positioned DOM cards in one large grid container, sized and cropped to a consistent aspect so the mosaic reads as dense and even; a very slow drift or scale (1 -> 1.02) over the shot keeps it from feeling static.
sound: A low ambient bed, no individual hits, letting the density speak.
prompt: Open on a tight, edge-to-edge grid of small generated-output tiles, different styles and subjects packed together with no gaps, drifting almost imperceptibly, to establish scale and variety before any words land.
